papers.title: Deterministic Retrieval Benchmarks for Agentic Search
papers.abstract: A deterministic benchmark corpus for evaluating agentic search and ingestion tool coverage, with fixed retrieval and caching behavior suitable for reproducible verification.

papers.title: Cache-Aware Tooling for Autonomous Research Agents
papers.abstract: An analysis of cache-aware tool design for autonomous research agents, covering shared cache keys, TTL bands, and stale-serving fallbacks under rate-limited upstream APIs.
